# fibery-cli

> Command-line interface for Fibery workspaces. Wraps the official HTTP API plus 15+ UI-discovered endpoints. Designed for human and AI agent consumers.

This repo follows the [llms.txt](https://llmstxt.org/) convention to make machine-readable documentation discoverable.

## Primary docs

- [README.md](README.md): Overview, install, credentials, command index, auto-extension loop
- [docs/AGENTS.md](docs/AGENTS.md): Output contract, exit codes, error signatures, sandbox conventions, idempotency, escalation flow
- [docs/CAPABILITIES.md](docs/CAPABILITIES.md): Point-in-time matrix of what is and isn't supported
- [docs/USAGE.md](docs/USAGE.md): Full command reference
- [docs/INTERNAL-API.md](docs/INTERNAL-API.md): UI-discovered Fibery endpoints (request shapes, samples)
- [docs/HAR-CLI-BUILDER.md](docs/HAR-CLI-BUILDER.md): How this CLI was built; protocol for extending it
- [docs/commands.json](docs/commands.json): Machine-readable catalog of every subcommand, flags, exit codes

## Optional

- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): Auto-discovery commit conventions, reviewer checklist
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md): Release log

## Agent quickstart

```
# read coverage before designing a multi-step flow
cat docs/CAPABILITIES.md

# enumerate subcommands programmatically
jq '.subcommands | keys' docs/commands.json

# default output is JSON, suitable for piping into agents
fibery <workspace> query "Space/Type" --where '...' -o json

# on "method not found" / "unknown command" / 404, escalate via the auto-extension loop
# instead of fabricating workarounds
```
